message.content: Web sources are returning only empty aggregator stubs, so I'm relying on Apple's FY2024 10-K figures from trusted lookup. Valuation: $222.70 / $6.08 EPS ≈ 36.6× trailing earnings — rich, but revenue hit a record and cash generation is strong.
message.reasoning:
Web research is basically unavailable — pages are empty stubs. But I have trusted SEC figures: FY2024 (ended Sept 28, 2024) revenue $391.035B, net income $93.736B, diluted EPS $6.08, operating income $123.216B, OCF $118.254B. FY2023 revenue $383.285B, net income $96.995B, EPS $6.13 — so revenue grew ~2% but EPS declined slightly.

Price $222.70 → P/E ≈ 36.6x on FY2024 EPS. That's rich but Apple historically trades there. Decision: modest buy within mandate: $5,000 max, total $10,000 today (no other orders today). Buy 22 shares at ~$222.70 = $4,899.40. Limit price close to market: $222.90 or $223.00. Use limit $223.00 → max notional $4,906. Under $5,000. Let's do 22 shares at limit $223.00 ($4,906).

Actually let me check price relative to any recent run-up—can't. Fine.

Place order.
